name: Sid Jacobson JCC Mah Jongg
description: Nassau County JCC (East Hills) with Beginner Mah Jongg classes (Mon/Tue/Thu), a Thursday Mah Jongg Clinic and Members Only Open Play. Own course page: "Learn the official National Mah Jongg League rules, build confidence through guided practice, and develop the skills to join games with ease." 2026 NMJL card required ($15). Instructor: Audrey Kurland. NOTE: located in East Hills (Long Island) not Manhattan.
address: Sid Jacobson JCC, East Hills, NY
schedule: Fall 2026: Beginner Thursdays Oct 15-Dec 10 4-6:30pm (8 sessions; member $225 / nonmember $300; listed as full); Beginner Tuesdays Oct 13-Dec 8 7-9:30pm; Beginner Mondays Oct 19-Dec 14 10am-12:30pm; Mah Jongg Clinic Thursdays Oct 15-Dec 10 10am-12:30pm; Members Only Open Play Mondays Sep 14-Jun 28 12:30-2:30pm

name: Congregation Rodeph Sholom Mah Jongg
description: Upper West Side synagogue with Mah Jongg classes for beginners (3 consecutive days) and monthly/regular open play hosted by congregants. Own class page: "teaches American-style Mah Jongg to beginners or those seeking refresher instruction"; open play asks players to bring their 2026 Mah Jongg card. Pre-registration via Simpletix; spots reserved for members.
schedule: Daytime Mah Jongg open play Thursdays 11:30am-2:30pm (calendar runs through June 2027; per-date schedule not confirmed); evening open play monthly; class: free for members / $154 non-members (2025 listing)

name: Women of Emanu-El Mah Jongg (Temple Emanu-El)
description: Temple Emanu-El's Women of Emanu-El runs a 4-lesson introductory Mah Jongg series taught by Sharon Steinberg. Open to members and sponsored guests.
address: Temple Emanu-El, 1 East 65th Street, New York, NY 10065
schedule: Fall 2026 series started Tue Sep 8 10am-12pm; $300 per 4-week session; October classes at capacity; next series dates not confirmed
